popupBudgetWindowDay.description: Names a daily budget's window inside popupLimitLine and popupLimitAlso, where it reads after a percentage: '132% of today's limit'.

popupBudgetWindowMonth.description: Names a monthly budget's window inside popupLimitLine and popupLimitAlso, where it reads after a percentage.

popupBudgetWindowSession.description: Names a session budget's window inside popupLimitLine and popupLimitAlso, where it reads after a percentage: '132% of this session's limit'.

popupBudgetWindowWeek.description: Names a weekly budget's window inside popupLimitLine and popupLimitAlso, where it reads after a percentage.

popupCacheSaved.description: Meta line entry for responses served from the browser cache. The tilde is deliberate and must be kept: the figure is the estimator's, not a measurement.

popupCacheSavedTitle.message: These responses came from the browser cache and cost no network bytes. What they would have cost is the estimator's figure, which is why it is tilded.

popupChartEmpty.message: No history for this period yet.
popupChartEmpty.description: Shown in place of the popup bar chart when the period has no buckets at all.

popupChartPeak.description: Note beside the popup chart heading, giving the tallest bar's value. Lower case; it is a note, not a sentence.

popupChartTitle.description: Heading of the popup panel holding the bar chart and the resource-type breakdown.

popupEmptyNoPlan.message: Nothing recorded for this period yet. Load a page and the numbers appear here.
popupEmptyNoPlan.description: The popup's single empty state, on a profile with no plan set.

popupEmptyWithPlan.message: Nothing recorded for this period yet. The figure above covers the whole plan cycle.
popupEmptyWithPlan.description: The popup's single empty state when a plan is set, where the headline is still showing a non-zero cycle total.

popupErrorCreateAllLimit.message: Could not create the limit over everything.
popupErrorCreateAllLimit.description: Shown when the 'Turn on' button under popupPlanAlertsTitle fails to create the limit.

popupErrorDismiss.description: Button that clears the popup's error line.

popupErrorGrant.description: Shown when the grant button fails.

popupErrorOptimize.description: Shown when switching Data Saver on or off for every site fails.

popupErrorPause.description: Shown when pausing a limit fails.

popupErrorReadUsage.description: Shown when the background worker does not answer a request for the current figures.

popupErrorRemove.description: Shown when deleting a limit fails.

popupErrorResume.description: Shown when resuming a paused limit fails.

popupErrorSetLimit.description: Shown when one of the preset buttons fails to create a limit.

popupErrorSiteOptimize.message: Could not change Data Saver for this site.
popupErrorSiteOptimize.description: Shown when the per-site Data Saver tick fails to save.

popupErrorTryAgain.description: Replaces popupErrorDismiss when polling has stopped, because pressing it restarts polling rather than only clearing the message.

popupFooterNote.message: One Chrome profile, on this device. Other browsers, other profiles, apps and anything else sharing the connection are not counted.
popupFooterNote.description: Standing note at the foot of the popup, bounding what every figure above it covers.

popupGrantWindowDay.description: Names a daily budget's window on the grant button and in its tooltip, where it reads after a byte figure: '+50 MB today'.

popupGrantWindowMonth.description: Names a monthly budget's window on the grant button and in its tooltip, where it reads after a byte figure.

popupGrantWindowSession.description: Names a session budget's window on the grant button and in its tooltip, where it reads after a byte figure: '+50 MB this session'.

popupGrantWindowWeek.description: Names a weekly budget's window on the grant button and in its tooltip, where it reads after a byte figure.

popupHeadlineOf.description: Second half of the popup headline when a plan is set: the used figure is set in large type in a sibling element and this follows it, so the whole reads '4.2 of 15 GB'.

popupLimitAlso.description: Names the second limit covering this tab, when a site limit and the limit over everything are both in force and only one of them is biting. WINDOW is one of the popupBudgetWindow* strings.

popupLimitGrant.description: Button that raises the allowance for the current window only. WINDOW is one of the popupGrantWindow* strings, so the whole reads '+50 MB today'.

popupLimitGrantTitle.message: Raises the allowance for $WINDOW$ from $FROM$ to $TO$. The extra belongs to this window only and is gone when it resets.

popupLimitHeading.description: Heading of the popup's limit card.

popupLimitLine.description: The limit card's figures, as one sentence. WINDOW is one of the popupBudgetWindow* strings, so the whole reads '1.1 MB of 800 kB · 132% of today's limit · resets in 3 hours'.

popupLimitLineUntilClose.message: $USED$ of $ALLOWANCE$ · $SHARE$ of $WINDOW$ · resets when the browser closes
popupLimitLineUntilClose.description: popupLimitLine for a session limit, which has no reset timestamp. A separate whole sentence rather than a fragment substituted into the other, so the final clause can be placed anywhere.

popupLimitMore.description: Link at the foot of the limit card. The popup's one route into the limits panel in settings.

popupLimitNearlyFull.description: Limit card status between 85% and 100% of the allowance.

popupLimitOver.description: Limit card status at or above 100% of the allowance. Describes the user's position, not the mechanism.

popupLimitPause.description: Button that suspends enforcement of the limit for an hour.

popupLimitPauseTitle.message: Stops refusing anything for an hour. The counter keeps running.
popupLimitPauseTitle.description: Tooltip on the popupLimitPause button. The second sentence matters: pausing does not pause measurement.

popupLimitPaused.description: Limit card status when the limit is snoozed and no resume time is recorded.

popupLimitPausedConsequence.message: Nothing is refused while paused. On resume: $DESCRIPTION$
popupLimitPausedConsequence.description: Limit card consequence line while the limit is snoozed. DESCRIPTION is the shared sentence for the enforcement tier that will apply again on resume.

description.example: Video and large images are refused.

popupLimitPausedUntil.description: Limit card status while the limit is snoozed. One sentence rather than a label plus a time, so the clause can be reordered.

popupLimitPresetLabel.description: One of the three preset buttons that create a daily limit on the current site. SIZE is a fixed byte figure, not a formatted setting.

popupLimitPresetTitle.message: Limits the site in this tab to $SIZE$ a day. Video goes at 60% of that, images and fonts at 85%, everything but the page's own HTML at 100%.
popupLimitPresetTitle.description: Tooltip on a preset button, stating what the limit will actually do.

popupLimitPrevented.description: Bytes a limit stopped from being fetched. The tilde is deliberate and must be kept: a refused request was never sent, so its size is the estimator's figure.

popupLimitPreventedTitle.message: $PERIOD$. A refused request is never dispatched, so it has no measured size — this is the size model's figure for what it would have weighed. Beacon-blocking contributes here too when Data Saver is on.
popupLimitPreventedTitle.description: Tooltip on popupLimitPrevented. PERIOD is the window the figure covers, composed elsewhere, and leads the sentence.

popupLimitRemove.description: Button that deletes the limit. The one destructive control in the popup; it takes two presses.

popupLimitRemoveArmed.description: The popupLimitRemove button's label after the first press, for five seconds, while a second press would actually delete the limit.

popupLimitRemoveConfirm.message: Press Remove again to delete the limit on $SITE$.
popupLimitRemoveConfirm.description: Announced to a screen reader when the Remove button is armed. 'Remove' here names the button and should match popupLimitRemove.

popupLimitRemoveTitle.message: Deletes the limit on $SITE$. The counter and the tier go with it.

popupLimitResume.description: Button that ends a pause and puts the limit back in force. Replaces popupLimitPause while the limit is paused.

popupLimitResumeTitle.message: Puts the limit back in force now.

popupLimitScopeAll.message: $LABEL$ — every site, not just this tab
popupLimitScopeAll.description: Scope line of the limit card when the limit covers all browsing. LABEL is the shared name for the all-sites key.

popupLimitWithin.description: Limit card status below 85% of the allowance.

popupMeasuredAll.description: Meta line label when at least 97% of the period's bytes came from a real size rather than the estimator.

popupMeasuredEstimatedShare.description: Meta line label when under 80% of the period's bytes were measured. The only band of the four that is a caveat, and the only one given the estimate colour.

popupMeasuredNearlyAll.description: Meta line label when 80–97% of the period's bytes came from a real size.

popupMeasuredNone.description: Meta line label when no bytes have been recorded for the period.

popupMeasuredTitle.message: Chrome does not tell an extension how big a response was. Content-Length and the page's own resource timing cover most of it; whatever they cannot, a learned per-host estimate fills in. This says how much of that happened.
popupMeasuredTitle.description: Tooltip shared by all four popupMeasured* labels. Explains why a byte count can be part measured and part estimated at all.

popupNoLimitHere.message: This tab is not showing a website, so there is nothing here to limit. Open a site and its own limit appears here. A limit over everything would still apply.
popupNoLimitHere.description: Limit card body on a page with no limitable site — a new tab, a PDF, a chrome:// page. This is the loudest thing in the popup for anyone whose first action after installing is to click the toolbar button on the new-tab page, so it leads with the reason and what to do rather than with what the product cannot do. The last sentence is a disclosure and stays: a limit over everything is enforced regardless of what this tab is showing.

popupNoLimitOnSite.message: No limit on $SITE$. A daily limit sheds video at 60%, images and fonts at 85%, and everything but the page's own HTML at 100%.
popupNoLimitOnSite.description: Limit card body when the current tab's site has no limit. States what a limit would do before the user sets one from the preset buttons underneath.

popupOpenDashboard.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the chart icon in the popup's top bar. Opens dashboard.html in a tab.

popupOpenSettings.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the gear icon in the popup's top bar. Opens settings.html in a tab.

popupOptimizeActiveHint.message: Images are requested at a smaller size where the service offers one, and analytics beacons are refused.
popupOptimizeActiveHint.description: Body of the popup Data Saver row while it is active on this site.

popupOptimizeDismissLabel.description: Accessible name of the cross that hides the Data Saver offer.

popupOptimizeDismissTitle.message: Hide this suggestion. Data Saver stays reachable in settings.
popupOptimizeDismissTitle.description: Tooltip on the cross that hides the Data Saver offer. Longer than the accessible name because it also says what hiding does not do.

popupOptimizeDismissed.message: Suggestion hidden. Data Saver is still in settings.
popupOptimizeDismissed.description: Announced to a screen reader after the Data Saver offer is dismissed, since the row it was reading has just gone.

popupOptimizeExcludedHint.message: This site is on the never-optimize list. Nothing here is rewritten or refused.
popupOptimizeExcludedHint.description: Body of the popup Data Saver row while this site is excluded.

popupOptimizeMeasuredDelta.description: Per-site saving measured by comparing optimized page loads against deliberately unoptimized ones. No tilde: this is a difference between two sets of real measurements, not a model's output.

popupOptimizeMeasuredDeltaTitle.message: Measured: $OPTIMIZED$ optimized page loads against $CONTROL$ deliberately unoptimized ones on this site over $DAYS$ days. The ± is the 95% interval — page weights are heavy-tailed, so the range is the result.
popupOptimizeMeasuredDeltaTitle.description: Tooltip on popupOptimizeMeasuredDelta, giving the sample the figure rests on.

popupOptimizeMeasuredHere.description: Fallback for popupOptimizeMeasuredDelta when this site has no controlled comparison yet. Also arithmetic rather than a model, so it also carries no tilde.

popupOptimizeMeasuredHereTitle.message: $PERIOD$. Arithmetic, not a model: the original variant's size was already on file, so this is what it weighed minus what the smaller one cost.
popupOptimizeMeasuredHereTitle.description: Tooltip on popupOptimizeMeasuredHere. PERIOD is the window the figure covers, composed elsewhere, and leads the sentence.

popupOptimizeOffEverywhere.description: Button that switches Data Saver off for every site. Deliberately not 'Turn off': the tick beside it turns it off for this site only, and the two are different actions.

popupOptimizeOffEverywhereTitle.message: Switches Data Saver off for every site. The tick beside it covers this site only.

popupOptimizeOffForSite.description: Heading of the popup Data Saver row when the feature is on but this site is on the never-optimize list.

popupOptimizeOffHint.message: It asks image services for a smaller version of the same picture, refuses analytics beacons, and stops feeds ordering images larger than they are shown. This row is also where you switch it back off.
popupOptimizeOffHint.description: Body of the popup row offering Data Saver, shown while it is off and the button beside it reads "Turn on". Names what it does and where the way back out is. The final sentence used to read "Switch it off again from here, for this site or for everything" — an instruction for undoing a state the reader is not in, next to a button offering to enter it.

popupOptimizeOffTitle.description: Heading of the popup row offering Data Saver, shown when the feature is off everywhere. 'Data Saver' is the product's name for its set of page optimizers.

popupOptimizeOnForSite.description: Heading of the popup Data Saver row when the feature is on and this site is not excluded.

popupOptimizeTurnOn.description: Button that switches Data Saver on for every site.

popupOptimizeTurnOnTitle.message: Eight optimizers, each one switchable in settings. Five are on by default.

popupOverlayLabel.description: Names the second band inside each bar of the popup chart. Says both things about the figure: those bytes were never transferred, and the number is part measured and part modelled.

popupPaceLess.description: Popup pace line when this period is lighter than the one before. Kept separate from popupPaceMore rather than taking 'more'/'less' as a placeholder, because a comparative cannot be dropped into a sentence unchanged in every language.

popupPaceMore.description: Popup pace line when this period is heavier than the one before. WINDOW is one of the popupPreviousWindow* strings.

popupPaceSame.description: Popup pace line when this period is within 5% of the one before. WINDOW is one of the popupPreviousWindow* strings.

popupPaceTitle.message: $CURRENT$ this period against $PREVIOUS$ in the window of the same length immediately before it. Both measured the same way.
popupPaceTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup's pace line, naming the two figures the comparison is made from.

popupPeriodLabel.description: Accessible name of the popup's session/today/week/month radio group.

popupPlanAlertsButton.description: Button that creates the limit described in popupPlanAlertsHint.

popupPlanAlertsHint.message: Alerts come from a limit over everything, not from the plan figure on its own. Turning them on creates one at $PLAN$ a month and tells you at 75%, 90% and 100%. It also enforces: video is refused from 60% of the plan and images and fonts from 85%. A page's own HTML always loads.
popupPlanAlertsHint.description: Body of the popup notice headed popupPlanAlertsTitle. States the consequence of pressing the button, including the enforcement the user did not ask for, before they press it.

popupPlanAlertsTitle.description: Heading of the popup notice shown when a plan size is recorded but no limit over everything exists, so no warning can ever fire.

popupPlanCtaButton.description: Button beside popupPlanCtaCopy. Opens the plan panel in settings.

popupPlanCtaCopy.message: No plan set, so this total has no denominator.
popupPlanCtaCopy.description: Shown in the popup in place of the plan meter when the user has never recorded a monthly allowance. 'Denominator' is meant literally: there is a number but nothing to divide it by.

popupPlanLine.description: Line under the plan meter. Assembled as one sentence so the two halves can be reordered; the middle dot is the separator used throughout this surface.

popupPlanMeterLabel.description: Accessible name of the plan progress bar in the popup. The bar's spoken value is popupPlanMeterValueText.

popupPlanMeterTitle.message: Spending the plan evenly would put you at $PACE$ by now — that is the mark on the bar.
popupPlanMeterTitle.description: Tooltip on the plan progress bar, explaining the pace marker drawn across it.

popupPlanMeterValueText.message: $USED$ of $TOTAL$, $SHARE$ of the plan, day $DAY$ of $DAYS$
popupPlanMeterValueText.description: Spoken value of the plan progress bar. Carries the whole sentence rather than the bare percentage, because '132' read on its own is not the fact.

popupPlusLimitCeiling.message: You are using all $COUNT$ free site limits. Remove one to set another, or open Settings to see Plus.
popupPlusLimitCeiling.description: Replaces the limit presets in the popup when a free install has reached its ceiling. Offers the free way out first, because removing a limit is a real answer and not a lesser one.

popupPreviousWindowMonth.description: Names the comparison window in the popup pace line, when the period is the month. Deliberately not a number of days, for the same reason as popupPreviousWindowWeek.

popupPreviousWindowSession.description: Names the comparison window in the popup pace line, when the period is the browsing session. Reads after 'more than' or 'About the same as'.

popupPreviousWindowToday.description: Names the comparison window in the popup pace line, when the period is today. Reads after 'more than' or 'About the same as'.

popupPreviousWindowWeek.description: Names the comparison window in the popup pace line, when the period is the week. Deliberately not 'the previous 7 days': a calendar week can be part-length, so naming a number of days would be wrong.

popupProjectionFigure.description: First part of the popup projection line. 'Projected' is load-bearing: this figure is modelled, not measured.

popupProjectionHeading.description: Heading of the popup block that models where the plan cycle will end up. The only modelled number on this surface.

popupProjectionOver.description: Follows popupProjectionFigure when the projection lands above the plan size.

popupProjectionRanOut.description: Past-tense form of popupProjectionRunsOut, used when the exhaustion date has already passed.

popupProjectionRunsOut.description: Last part of the popup projection line, for a date still in the future. Lower case because it follows a middle dot on the same line.

popupProjectionShow.message: Show how this is worked out
popupProjectionShow.description: Button under the projection that reveals the full basis sentence. Toggles to popupProjectionShowLess.

popupProjectionShowLess.description: The popupProjectionShow button's label while the full basis sentence is showing.

popupProjectionSpare.description: Follows popupProjectionFigure when the projection lands below the plan size.

popupReadAgo.description: Meta line entry shown once the figures on screen are more than ten seconds old, so a stale payload is described rather than presented as live.

popupSiteOpenTitle.description: Tooltip on an ordinary site list row. Clicking the row opens that site's detail view in the dashboard.

popupSiteReservedTitle.message: Requests that did not belong to a tab: browser services, service workers and other extensions.
popupSiteReservedTitle.description: Tooltip on the site list row that collects requests with no page behind them.

popupSiteShare.description: The right-hand figure on a site list row: this site's share of the period's bytes.

popupSiteShareEstimated.description: popupSiteShare with the caveat appended, used when under 75% of this site's bytes were measured. Written as one whole string rather than a suffix, so the caveat can go wherever it belongs.

popupSiteTagCurrent.description: Tag on the site list row for the site open in the current tab.

popupSitesCountOne.description: Note beside the Sites heading when exactly one site was recorded.

popupSitesCountOther.description: Note beside the Sites heading for any count other than one. Chrome's message format has no plural rules, so the two forms are separate messages and the code picks between them on count === 1.

popupSitesSeeAll.description: Button under the popup site list once it is already expanded and there are still more sites than it will show.

popupSitesShowAll.description: Button under the popup site list while it is showing the top six of more.

popupSitesTitle.description: Heading of the popup's site list panel.

popupStaleTitle.message: The background worker has not answered since then, which is ordinary after an idle gap. These are the last figures it sent, not live ones.

popupTypesCaption.description: Accessible caption of the popup's resource-type breakdown bar (images, video, scripts and so on).
